svg.title: Analytical angular phase portrait: wave D plus
svg.desc: The model D plus equals Y00 plus 0.7 i Y20. Radius is normalized angular yield and color is phase in radians. Switching to its complex conjugate D minus preserves the yield and reverses the angular phase gradient. Both angular factors are energy independent and have zero EWS delay. The gradient at 45 degrees is minus 2.04 radians per radian for D plus.
svg.text: Same yield and EWS delay. Opposite angular phase gradients.
